requirements.description: User prefers an energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C. Area, capacity, Turin location and public transport access are not energy-related and were not included.
User wants the property located near public transport. Value set to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.
A university student residence requires easy access to universities and schools. Value set to the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, mapped to the surface_area column as the resulting total surface value.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: office property type, surface_area >= 850, energy class A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71, education >= 75, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892. The 60-person capacity is not an extracted requirement and has no allowlisted column, so it is not applied. Results are ordered by distance to the centre point.
